interpretation: Four new ordinary-control runs compared descriptively with all twelve historical P111 rows. Outcomes of P111 were known before this plan. No confirmatory or causal claim; no change to P111 gates. A descriptive criterion requires known costs and evaluations, no success loss, and lower all-task and paired-successful costs. Unknown use is not zero; missing slots have no cost bound. The same four tasks are shared across three comparisons.
